title: Chat markdown: bold next to full-width punctuation renders as literal asterisks (「**《书名》，借书人**」)
body:
repo:cloud#5 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9

Part of objectstack-ai/cloud#3825 (seen on 11-13 in the hosted chat). Ruled on objectstack-ai/cloud#3825 by the account owner in seat session `session_01Q4EjjPP1zuWBNq3nBXVei9`: 「同意」 to the decision request (comment 6891267721), so all four items as recommended. The promotion bar is unchanged: ≥95% correct, 100% cited, 0 leaks (comment 6721225525).

## Change

In the chat renderer (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`), `**…**` next to CJK full-width punctuation renders as literal asterisks. Fix the emphasis parsing for CJK punctuation boundaries so that 「**《书名》，借书人**」 renders bold. Add tests.
